text.en:
Barangays Bien Unido, Tuboran, Mandawa, Nueva Estrella, Nueva Esperanza, Puerto San
Pedro, Sagasa, Pinamgo, Bilangbilangan Daku, Bilangbilangan Diyot, Hingotanan, Maomaoan, and Malingin;
the islands of Cabantulan and Macaina; and the shoals of Dunggoan Daku. Dunggoan Gamay, and Labongan,
all in the Municipality of Talibon; and Barangay Liberty in the Municipality of Trinidad, all in the Province of
Bohol, are hereby separated from said municipalities and constituted into an independent and distinct
municipality, to be known as the Municipality of Bien Unido, Province of Bohol.
The seat of government of the new municipality shall be in Barangay Bien Unido.

The new municipality of Bien Unido shall be bounded as follows:
"From the intersection of Cambanha Creek, Nueva Esperanza, Talibon and Ipil River (point 1), thence N
13-00 E., 1,650 m. to point 2; thence N 18-45 E., 4,700 m. to point 3; thence N 72-00 E., 1,000 m. to point 4
(mouth of Suba River); thence N 62-45 E., 650 m. to point 5; thence N 45-00 E., 800 m. to point 6 (source of
Suba River); thence N 22-45 E., 17,800) m. to point 7; thence N 20-30 E,. 2,500 m. to point 8; thence S 66-30
E,. 15,750 m. to point 9; thence S 43-30 W., 21,250 m. to point 10; thence S 54-00 W., 7,450 m. to point 11;
thence S 3-30 W., 600 m. to point 12 (Atuay Creek, Liberty, Trinidad); thence S 86-00 W., 3,500 m. to point
13 (stock); thence N 58-00 W., 967 m. to point 14 (Nacon Hill); thence N 85-00 W., 1,650 m. to point 1, point
of beginning (Cambanha Creek), with an approximate total area of 30,885.00 hectares."
